prompts.text: Name a station on the North-South Line
prompts.note: The red line, Jurong East to Marina South Pier. Future stations (Brickland, Sungei Kadut) don't count yet.

prompts.text: Name a station on the East-West Line
prompts.note: The green line, Pasir Ris to Tuas Link, including the Changi Airport branch (Expo, Changi Airport).

prompts.text: Name a station on the North East Line
prompts.note: The purple line, HarbourFront to Punggol Coast.

prompts.text: Name a station on the Circle Line
prompts.note: Includes the three stations that opened in July 2026 (Keppel, Cantonment, Prince Edward Road) and the unopened Bukit Brown station.

prompts.text: Name a station on the Downtown Line
prompts.note: The blue line, Bukit Panjang to Expo, plus the extension to Xilin and Sungei Bedok (built, due to open in late 2026).

prompts.text: Name a station on the Thomson-East Coast Line
prompts.note: The brown line. Built-but-unopened stations count (Mount Pleasant, Marina South, Bedok South, Sungei Bedok); Founders' Memorial, still under construction, doesn't.

answers.name: Gardens by the Bay
aliases: Gardens by the Bay MRT Station

prompts.note: Any station where you can change lines, including MRT-LRT links (e.g. Sengkang), the Changi Airport branch (Tanah Merah, Expo) and Sungei Bedok (DTL/TEL, due to open in late 2026).
Any station on the Bukit Panjang, Sengkang or Punggol LRT. Ten Mile Junction closed in 2019, so it doesn't count.

prompts.text: Name a bus interchange or bus terminal
prompts.note: Any public bus interchange or terminal operating as of October 2026.
